t: 教皇乌尔班二世确认在阿布里塞尔的罗伯特领导下建立的拉罗埃修道院是一个正规的教规社区。
te: Pope Urban II confirms the foundation of the abbey of La Roë under Robert of Arbrissel as a community of canons regular.
dz: 教皇乌尔班二世确认在阿布里塞尔的罗伯特领导下建立的拉罗埃修道院是一个正规的教规社区。
de: Pope Urban II confirms the foundation of the abbey of La Roë under Robert of Arbrissel as a community of canons regular.

t: 大约 800 名犹太人在德国沃尔姆斯被屠杀。
te: Around 800 Jews are massacred in Worms, Germany.
dz: 第一次十字军东征：大约 800 名犹太人在德国沃尔姆斯被屠杀。
de: First Crusade: Around 800 Jews are massacred in Worms, Germany.

t: 埃米乔伯爵进入美因茨,他的追随者在那里屠杀了犹太公民. 至少600名犹太人被杀死.
te: Count Emicho enters Mainz, where his followers massacre Jewish citizens. At least 600 Jews are killed.
dz: 埃米乔伯爵进入美因茨,他的追随者在那里屠杀了犹太公民. 至少600名犹太人被杀死.
de: Count Emicho enters Mainz, where his followers massacre Jewish citizens. At least 600 Jews are killed.

t: 教皇乌尔班二世设定的第一次十字军东征的开始日期。
te: Starting date of the First Crusade as set by Pope Urban II.
dz: 教皇乌尔班二世设定的第一次十字军东征的开始日期。
de: Starting date of the First Crusade as set by Pope Urban II.

t: 一支塞尔柱克土耳其军队在西维托特战役中成功伏击了人民十字军.
te: A Seljuk Turkish army successfully ambushes the People's Crusade at the Battle of Civetot.
dz: 一支塞尔柱克土耳其军队在西维托特战役中成功伏击了人民十字军.
de: A Seljuk Turkish army successfully ambushes the People's Crusade at the Battle of Civetot.
